BESTIARY.Title: Bestiary

Keybinding.OpenHint: Opens or closes the Bestiary window. Every user can bind their own key.

Settings.OpenBestiaryHint: Use the button above to open the Bestiary. You can also use the hotkey (Shift+B by default) or the button in the Journal tab.
Settings.TierMenuHint: World-wide rules: at which tier each block of a creature card is revealed.
Settings.AllowSharingHint: Players may share creatures they have studied. Nobody can pass on more than they know themselves.
Settings.ResearchRollHint: Players can raise a tier by rolling a skill check straight from the creature card.
Settings.SingleAttemptHint: After a failed check, retries are blocked until the GM resets that knowledge.

BESTIARY.ConfirmDelete: Delete this collection together with every creature inside it?
BESTIARY.ConfirmRemoveCreature: Remove this creature from the collection?
BESTIARY.DropHint: Drop NPC actors or an actor folder here
BESTIARY.NoCreatures: This collection has no creatures yet.
BESTIARY.NoSections: No collections yet. Create the first one.
BESTIARY.NoActiveGm: No active GM — the change cannot be saved.

Tier.UnknownHint: The creature has been seen, but nothing is known about it.
Tier.RumorsHint: Its look, name and general nature are known.
Tier.StudiedHint: Combat statistics and core abilities are known.
Tier.MasteredHint: Everything is known, down to rare tricks and lore.
Tier.NeverHint: The block is never shown to players, at any tier.
Tier.ItemHint: The tier at which players can see this entry
Tier.EntryHint: These values override the world defaults for this entry only.
Tier.ResetDone: Tier overrides for this creature were cleared.
Tier.WorldHint: Choose the tier at which each block of a card is revealed. Individual creatures may override these values.
Tier.NothingKnownHint: Raise your research tier to reveal this creature's statistics.

Group.IdentityHint: Artwork, name and nature of the creature
Group.VitalsHint: AC, hit points, challenge and speed

Knowledge.PartyHint: Sets the same tier for every player in the world.
Knowledge.ConfirmReset: Reset every player's knowledge of this creature?

Research.DcHint: Leave empty to derive the DC from the creature's challenge rating.
Research.SkillsHint: With nothing selected, the skill is picked from the creature type.
Research.Blocked: No further attempts — ask your GM.
Research.NoActor: No character available to roll with.
Research.RollFailed: The roll could not be made.
Research.ChatBody: {actor} recalls what they know about {creature}: {skill} — {total} against DC {dc}.
Research.ChatFailure: Failure: nothing new comes to mind.

Share.Title: Share a creature
Share.Lead: Who should receive what you know about {name}?
Share.CapNote: You cannot pass on more than you know, and sharing never lowers what someone already has.
Share.NothingToShare: You do not know anything about this creature yet.
Share.NoRecipients: There is nobody else to share with.

Comments.ChannelGmHint: GM notes. Hidden ones are GM-only, shared ones are visible to everybody.
Comments.ChannelPartyHint: Shared notes visible to every player and the GM.

Lock.Hint: A lock freezes tier assignments and notes until the GM lifts it.
Lock.Blocked: The sheet is locked — changes are unavailable.
Lock.CommentsBlocked: Sheet locked: new notes and edits are unavailable.

Families.Title: Family
Families.ConfirmDelete: Delete this family? Its creatures stay in the collection without a family.
Families.Name: Family name
Families.Hint: Families group related creatures inside a collection.
Families.Empty: This family is empty — drop creatures here

Entry.Title: Entry settings
Entry.Missing: This entry is no longer part of the collection.
Entry.FitHint: "Fit whole" shows the artwork uncropped over a blurred backdrop. "Crop" fills the tile, centred on the focal point.
Entry.FocusHint: Click or drag across the artwork to set the focal point

Import.Title: Bulk import
Import.Lead: Pick a source and tick the creatures to add to this collection.
Import.CopyToWorldHint: Otherwise entries stay compendium links: not editable, but the world stays small.
Import.LoadFailed: The source could not be read.
Import.FolderEmpty: That folder holds no NPC actors.

Transfer.ImportSummary: The file holds {sections} collection(s) and {creatures} creature(s).
Transfer.ImportNote: Structure is imported: collections, families, tier settings and framing. Player knowledge and notes do not travel between worlds.
Transfer.ReplaceWarning: Your current collections will be replaced entirely by the file. Continue?
Transfer.ErrorNotJson: The file is not valid JSON.
Transfer.ErrorForeign: The file was produced by a different module.

BESTIARY.CollectionsHint: Organise creatures into themed collections and families
BESTIARY.RecentlyAddedHint: The latest creatures across every collection
BESTIARY.ToggleFavorite: Add to or remove from favorites
BESTIARY.SelectCreatureHint: A quick preview will appear here.
BESTIARY.OnlyNpcActors: Only NPC actors can be added to the bestiary.
BESTIARY.CreatureUnavailable: This card is hidden or its collection is unavailable.
BESTIARY.CreatureLoadError: The creature data could not be loaded

BulkResearch.Title: Check settings
BulkResearch.Hint: Change research checks for multiple entries. Locked entries are skipped; other settings are preserved.
BulkResearch.Summary: {count} entries in scope · {skipped} locked entries skipped
BulkResearch.PickSkill: Select at least one skill, or choose automatic selection.
BulkResearch.Done: Research settings applied to unlocked entries in the selected scope.
